title: Logos / Portrait lockup
slide_intent: Adapt a fixed signature to tall spaces because composition shape affects which recognition cue can lead.
strategic_value: A larger Duo above the name can help Duolingo stand out among other apps and brands.
demonstration: A stacked logo specimen accompanies instructions for square or tall third-party placements.
practical_value: Select the portrait version when the supplied logo must fit a square or tall area.

content_islands.name: Stacked specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the prominent Duo above the wordmark within the left panel.

content_islands.name: Third-party guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, recognition rationale and square-or-tall condition at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says Duo’s larger, prominent placement helps the brand stand out.
reference_purposes.Application: The source directs this version to third-party use within square or tall spaces.

ingredient.name: Portrait lockup
ingredient.role: Lead with the mascot in a compact vertical signature.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied stacked version for third-party logos in square or tall spaces.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical portrait lockup; does not replace the landscape version in all contexts.
